input.description: A retired keeper returns to a remote island lighthouse after a ship vanishes in a storm, and finds letters that change how she sees her own past.
input.cover_ideas: A lone lighthouse on a rocky cliff at dusk, storm clouds, a faint beam over a dark sea

base_prompt: A solitary weathered lighthouse perched on a jagged rocky cliff at dusk, its faint golden beam cutting through heavy storm clouds over a dark, restless sea. Moody literary mystery atmosphere, cinematic lighting, deep indigo and slate tones with a warm beam, wind-whipped spray, dramatic clouds, photorealistic painterly book cover, no text.
text_prompt: Add typography to the book cover image of a lone lighthouse on a rocky cliff at dusk, with storm clouds and a faint beam over a dark sea. Place the title "The Last Lighthouse Keeper" prominently in the upper third, centered, in an elegant high-contrast serif typeface with slightly condensed letterforms and refined, literary weight—not ornate fantasy script and not heavy thriller block lettering. Set the title in off-white or warm ivory so it reads clearly against the dusk sky and storm clouds, with a subtle dark drop shadow or soft edge glow only if needed for contrast. Allow the title to break across two or three balanced lines ("The Last" / "Lighthouse" / "Keeper" or "The Last Lighthouse" / "Keeper") so it feels spacious and prominent without crowding the lighthouse. Below the title, or alternatively along the lower third above the dark sea, place the author name "Mara Ellison" in a smaller complementary serif or refined small-caps style, roughly one-third the visual size of the title, letterspaced slightly, in the same ivory tone or a muted warm gold. Keep both text blocks clear of the lighthouse beam and the cliff silhouette, with generous margins, strong contrast, and a quiet, mysterious literary-fiction mood.
